title: Extrema with Absolute Value Piecewise Corners
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the absolute extrema of f(x) = |x^2 - 4| on [-3, 3].
finalAnswer: \text{Absolute Maximum: } 5 \text{ at } x = \pm 3; \quad \text{Absolute Minimum: } 0 \text{ at } x = \pm 2

steps.title: Locate Points of Non-Differentiability
steps.mathExpression: x^2 - 4 = 0 \implies x = \pm 2 \implies f'(x) \text{ does not exist at } x = \pm 2
steps.explanation: The corners of the absolute value occur where the interior is zero.
steps.why: Points where f' DNE are critical points.

steps.title: Evaluate All Candidates
steps.explanation: Compare candidate values: min is 0, max is 5.
